"""Final100us numerical attribution; no rerun of the accepted genesis history."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib

helper=Path('/tmp/a1-body-contact-time-attribution-20260927.py').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(helper).hexdigest()=='43eaf9ab10df129666d9eb2089d7e4505f18c8ef41e651f8653f3e2e7947da5d'
exec(compile(helper.decode().split('\ncopies={}',1)[0],'<authenticated body comparison helpers>','exec'))
source=Path('docs/evidence/FB-01aj-current-law-genesis.json').read_bytes()
SOURCE_SHA='f2a5cbd29eaed4ab8a9974f8bddac8ff4a52aaa63ed85f8440a156ef6cb10ca0'
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()==SOURCE_SHA
pack=json.loads(source)['raw_measurement'];body=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(pack['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
assert len(body)==pack['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()==pack['raw_sha256']
archive=json.loads(body)
assert archive['first_failure']['metric']=='specific_force_m_s2'
assert archive['first_failure']['channel']=='guala/left/foot/inertial/specific-force'
lanes={x['label']:x for x in archive['lanes']}
assert set(lanes)=={'coarse','half'}
START=lanes['coarse']['last_attempt']['start_s'];STOP=lanes['coarse']['last_attempt']['end_s']
assert all(c['last_attempt']['start_s']==START and c['last_attempt']['end_s']==STOP for c in lanes.values())
MAX=2*sum(len(c['last_attempt']['admission']['accepted']) for c in lanes.values());assert MAX==20
probe=radau.RadauProbe(MAX*(5+radau.MAX_SECANT*2*radau.MAX_LINE))
audit={'all_forward_calls':0,'outside_ceiling':64,'ceiling':probe.ceiling+64}
result=dict(schema='guala.functional-body.acceleration-attribution.v1',source_sha256=SOURCE_SHA,
    completed=False,failure=None,mounted=False,full_body_qualification=False,continuum_enclosure=False,
    incremental_work_and_impulse_scope=[START,STOP],scope='fixed-piece crossed tails, not new admission',
    cases=[],initial_states=[],comparisons={},attempts=0,limits=dict(primitive_attempts=MAX,cpu_seconds=8.))
copies={};initials={};started,cpu_start=time.perf_counter(),time.process_time()
mj.mj_forward=forward
try:
    controls=archived_controls()
    for origin,lane in lanes.items():
        entry=lane['last_attempt'];saved=base64.b64decode(entry['predecessor_base64'],validate=True)
        c=Trajectory(100,controls[100]);initials[origin]=c
        record=dict(origin=origin,expected_raw_base64=raw(saved),supply_j=entry['supply_j'])
        result['initial_states'].append(record)
        try:restore(c,saved,entry['supply_j'])
        finally:record.update(actual_raw_base64=raw(primary(c.e)),time_s=float(c.d.time))
        record['observation']=asdict(c.e._observation());assert c.d.time==START
    # Comparison metric time is the actual predecessor time, not the final time.
    initial_errors=Errors();a,b=initials['coarse'],initials['half']
    initial_errors.compare(a,b,a.snapshot(),b.snapshot(),START*1e6)
    result['initial_comparison']=dict(metrics=initial_errors.result(),first_failure=initial_errors.first_failure)
    for origin,lane in lanes.items():
        entry=lane['last_attempt'];saved=base64.b64decode(entry['predecessor_base64'],validate=True)
        for mesh,ref_lane in lanes.items():
            tail=ref_lane['last_attempt']['admission']['accepted'];control=origin==mesh
            c=Trajectory(100,controls[100]);copies[origin,mesh]=c
            row=dict(origin=origin,mesh=mesh,control=control,predecessor_base64=raw(saved),
                initial_supply_j=entry['supply_j'],expected_observation=lane['observation'] if control else None,
                steps=[],completed=False)
            result['cases'].append(row)
            try:
                restore(c,saved,entry['supply_j']);assert c.d.time==START
                for ref in tail:
                    if result['attempts']>=MAX or time.process_time()-cpu_start>=8.:raise RuntimeError('bounded attribution exhausted')
                    result['attempts']+=1;before=primary(c.e)
                    step=dict(start_s=float(c.d.time),end_s=ref['end_s'],supply_j=c.supply,
                        predecessor_sha256=hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),returned=False,
                        expected=ref if control else None)
                    row['steps'].append(step)
                    try:value=probe.step(c.e,ref['end_s']-c.d.time,c.supply)
                    except Exception:
                        step.update(rollback_exact=primary(c.e)==before,solver=probe.steps[-1]);raise
                    step.update(returned=True,successor_base64=raw(primary(c.e)),work=value[1])
                    c.work=interval._work_add(c.work,value[1]);c.impulses=interval._impulse_add(c.impulses,value[2])
                    c.supply=entry['supply_j']-c.work[0]
                    if control:
                        assert step['predecessor_sha256']==ref['predecessor_sha256']
                        assert c.d.time==ref['end_s'] and step['supply_j']==ref['available_work_j']
                        assert primary(c.e)==base64.b64decode(ref['state']['float64_le_base64'],validate=True)
                        assert list(value[1])==ref['work']
                row['completed']=True
            finally:
                row.update(state_base64=raw(primary(c.e)),time_s=float(c.d.time),work=c.work,remaining_supply_j=c.supply)
                row['impulses']=impulses_record(c.impulses)
                row['observation']=asdict(c.e._observation())
            if control:
                row['control_observation_exact']=(json.dumps(row['observation'],sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)
                    ==json.dumps(row['expected_observation'],sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
                assert row['control_observation_exact']
    for origin in lanes:
        result['comparisons']['same_initial_'+origin]=compare(copies[origin,'coarse'],copies[origin,'half'])
    for mesh in lanes:
        result['comparisons']['same_mesh_'+mesh]=compare(copies['coarse',mesh],copies['half',mesh])
    result['completed']=True
except Exception as error:
    result['failure']=dict(type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc(limit=7))
finally:
    mj.mj_forward=native_forward
    result.update(calls=probe.calls,call_accounting=audit,native_seconds=probe.native_seconds,
        cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-cpu_start,wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started)
print(json.dumps(encode(result)),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import sys

helper=Path('/tmp/a1-loaded-contact-run-20260927.py').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(helper).hexdigest()=='a75f28ae491567cd010e5ff4d50118d1b2cbe41298c9e9867055f3432acabb91'
prefix,_=helper.decode().split('\nassert Path.cwd()==ROOT and not TARGET.exists()',1)
exec(compile(prefix,'<reviewed bounded operational helpers>','exec'))
FP='216be540bdf9b0b37d66e730c5926ef39f2e149c34526634ee72cd6abefeb4f5'
TARGET=ROOT/'docs/evidence/FB-01aj-acceleration-attribution.json'
PROOF=Path('/tmp/a1-body-acceleration-attribution-20260927.py')
ABI=Path('/tmp/guala-body-contact-estimator.qmush2pu/python/guala_body_interval.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so')
RADAU=ABI.parent/'guala_body_radau.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so'
expected={PROOF:'c517a840b15d8f63efa332ffcdf13b62bbc3adfa02ac0a28a0bcfe387a9177c9',
    Path('/tmp/a1-body-contact-time-attribution-20260927.py'):'43eaf9ab10df129666d9eb2089d7e4505f18c8ef41e651f8653f3e2e7947da5d',
    ROOT/'native/functional_body/interval.pyx':'8391d81b1147e1973e1b147fc63c456176b46bc39137e8afa8f6fa2f118b7119',
    ROOT/'native/functional_body/radau.pyx':'605d88391082809cdebdfc6a9b2ed888103114d59d5e08ebdc5cbed16adfd92b',
    ABI:'102b1db8cdf60bb2808117bb685eb907c9a449c2c1ea9d1bb9a826799a80580d',
    RADAU:'3f2525fa5e9a7b4bebf1ead9a88fe3efabf06bf652fb73eae56061f9d0f50d61',LIB:LIB_SHA}
assert Path.cwd()==ROOT and not TARGET.exists()
for p,s in expected.items():assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s,str(p)
fingerprint()
pre=health();print('PRE_HEALTH',json.dumps(pre),flush=True);require_health(pre)
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',
    LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(LIB.parent),GUALA_RADAU_PROOF_ABI=str(RADAU),

        '/tmp/guala-body-native.pnUH8P/lib/python3.11/site-packages:.:tests:tools')
code="""import socket
def deny(*a,**k):raise RuntimeError('offline child forbids network')
socket.socket.connect=deny
socket.socket.connect_ex=deny
socket.socket.sendto=deny
import json,resource,runpy
import mujoco as mj,guala_body_interval as interval
assert mj.__version__==mj.mj_versionString()=='3.3.7+guala.midpoint-step.1'
assert interval.__file__=="""+repr(str(ABI))+"\n"+"""try:
 runpy.run_path("""+repr(str(PROOF))+""",run_name='__main__')
finally:
 r=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
 print('CHILD_RESOURCES',json.dumps(dict(cpu_seconds=r.ru_utime+r.ru_stime,maxrss_kib=r.ru_maxrss)))
"""
execution,out=child(code,env,'saved-acceleration-attribution')
post=health();print('POST_HEALTH',json.dumps(post),flush=True)
health_error=None
try:
    require_health(post)
    assert pre['observation']['identity']==post['observation']['identity']
    assert pre['service']==post['service']
    assert post['observation']['live_tick']>=pre['observation']['live_tick']
except Exception as error:health_error=repr(error)

for p,s in expected.items():assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s
packed=result=resources=None;progress=[]
for line in out.splitlines():

    if line.startswith('PROGRESS '):progress.append(json.loads(line.split(' ',1)[1]));continue
    if not line.startswith('{'):continue
    value=json.loads(line);b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(value['payload_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert len(b)==value['raw_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==value['raw_sha256']

passed=(measured and result['completed'] and result['failure'] is None and result['attempts']==20 and result['cpu_seconds']<8)

    summary['comparisons']={k:dict(passed=v['complete_local_comparison_passed'],first_failure=v['first_failure']) for k,v in result['comparisons'].items()}
